title: QAE Scenario Specification Format (DRAFT)
description: Phase 0.5 scenario SPECIFICATIONS ([CTO-QAE-001] §17). Expected outputs are never invented: each expectation block carries a source label. CHARACTERIZED_EXISTING expectations reference oracle code (file:line) and are goldenPending until the Phase-1 oracle harness machine-generates their values. RESEARCH_REQUIRED/UNRESOLVED blocks document the scenario without executable numbers.

input.description: Structured scenario input. Canonical units (NUMERIC-CONTRACT). For weeklyReview scenarios, observation summaries describe the series the Phase-1 harness will expand into RawObservation arrays.

goldenPending.description: true ⇒ numeric goldens to be machine-generated from the oracle in Phase 1; assertions here are the binding contract of WHAT gets pinned

oracleRef.description: file:line in the legacy oracle backing a CHARACTERIZED_EXISTING assertion
